_purpose: One record per dubizzle tenant for analytics work: origin, locale facts that change tracking, and the GA4 / GTM / Firebase / BigQuery ids. The design system itself is measured on Egypt only; this file is the only multi-tenant layer.
_rules: null means unknown. Never fill an id from memory or a guess; ask the owner or read it from live with `npm run extract:tracking -- --tenant=XX`.
currency.decimals are ISO 4217 minor units (KWD, BHD, OMR, JOD = 3; EGP, SAR = 2). Prices go to GA4 as numbers, never formatted strings.
digits: Western everywhere (D-020) is decided for Egypt only; other tenants are unconfirmed until measured.
